audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 4 read Skill while whys[3] and whys[4] on the same page say 'favours Olaf', and row 6 read Olaf while whys[6] says 'favours you' and the late paragraph says the matchup flips.
audit.why: Levels 4-6 are the deepest part of Olaf's window — Reckless Swing (E) true damage on 7-11s, Tough It Out (W) shield, and Ragnarok (R) at 100s that ignores your slow. The 2+ item row is the only one that goes back to Urgot, which is what the packet chart and every prose string here already say.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 = Olaf at 3/10, row 6 = Urgot at 6/10, all proposed as matched full/content pairs in one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Late spike credits 'your %HP W Purge' for flipping the matchup, and the late paragraph repeats '%HP shred on W Purge'.
audit.why: Neither Riot's description of Purge nor any derived flag shows percent-health damage on Urgot. The mirror hit the same claim and left it as unverified. Urgot's real late spike, which the mirror states from Olaf's side, is that maxed Purge costs 0 mana on a 0s cooldown — permanent Echoing Flames uptime in a long brawl.
audit.corrected: Both strings rewritten off the verified rank-5 Purge property instead of the unverified percent-health claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Olaf's W 'Vicious Strikes' and credits it with lifesteal, in both spikes[0].text and the mid paragraph.
audit.why: Olaf's W is Tough It Out — 16s at rank 1 falling to 12s, and Riot's text is only 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield'. There is no lifesteal on it. His sustain is the passive, Berserker Rage: attack speed and life steal scaling with MISSING health, so the lower he drops the harder the extended trade gets. That inversion is the whole reason short trades beat long ones here.
audit.corrected: Tough It Out (W) is a 16s attack-speed shield — force it out before you commit. His lifesteal is Berserker Rage and it grows as he drops, so never grind a long trade. Reckless Swing (E) is true damage on 11s at rank 1, 325 range, and it costs him health unless it kills. Undertow (Q) is 9s but resets the moment he walks over the axe — walking over it first denies the reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no numbers and did not mention the Undertow pickup reset.
audit.why: The axe reset is the reason his 9s Q is effectively much shorter when you let him retrieve it.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] says to 'kite with W Purge'.
audit.why: Purge SLOWS Urgot while he channels it — Riot's text is explicit. It is a contact tool, not a kiting tool, and against a champion whose whole plan is sticking to you that distinction decides fights.
audit.corrected: Save Purge for contact; it self-slows you.
